name: get_order_plan
description: The store's order plan for the next 13 weeks: every order the forecast needs, grouped by supplier (or by vendor when no supplier is set), with order quantities after case packs and minimums, order-by and arrival dates, units and cost per supplier, the cash needed, and cash per week for windows over 14 days. Use for 'what do I need to reorder this week', 'what should I order from <supplier>' and 'how much cash do I need for stock next month'.

supplier.description: Supplier or vendor name, or part of it. Leave out for all suppliers.

within_days.description: Orders whose order-by date falls within this many days from today; overdue orders are always included. 1 for today, 7 for this week, 30 for next month, 90 for the whole 13-week plan. Default 14.

name: get_product_stock
description: Stock and forecast for products matching a search: status (Out, Running low, Healthy, Too much, Dead, Not enough data), stock on hand, incoming, units on order with Keha and their arrival date, sales per day while in stock, days of stock left, the order-by date and the suggested order quantity, per variant. Use for 'when does <product> run out', 'how much <product> do I have' and 'should I reorder <product>'.

query.description: Product title, variant name (such as a color or size) or SKU. Several words narrow the match, for example 'blue hoodie'.

name: get_action_list
description: This week's stock actions, ranked by money at stake: reorder (order more stock), sold_out (a best seller is sold out: collect back-in-stock sign-ups until stock arrives), push (promote products with healthy stock), fix (missing sizes, weak product pages, high returns, falling sales) and clear (discount slow or dead stock). Each action has the product, the amount at stake in the store currency and the reason in one sentence. Use for 'what should I do this week' or 'which products need attention'.

kind.description: Only this kind of action. Leave out for all kinds.

name: get_money_at_stake
description: The store's money at stake from its stock, in the store currency, with how each number was calculated: sales at risk in the next 28 days, sales lost to sell-outs in the last 90 days, cash stuck in too much stock and dead stock, sold-out page visits in the last 30 days, and the value of dead stock on its own. Use for 'what is my dead stock worth', 'how much cash is tied up in stock' and 'how much am I losing to stockouts'.

name: get_purchase_orders
description: Open purchase orders: drafts, sent and confirmed orders made in Keha, and Shopify purchase orders that are ordered but not received. Each has the order number, supplier, status, expected arrival date, units and value. Use for 'which purchase orders are still open' and 'when does my order from <supplier> arrive'.

status.description: Only orders with this status. Leave out for all open orders.

supplier.description: Supplier name, or part of it. Leave out for all suppliers.

name: get_forecast_accuracy
description: How accurate the sales forecasts were in recent months: the error of the store-total forecast and of the top 20 products, in percent (lower is better), from comparing each month's saved forecast with what really sold. Use for 'how accurate are the forecasts' or 'can I trust the reorder suggestions'.

months.description: How many recent graded months to return. Default 3.
